sketch:
Observe: SVG canvas showing a Torricelli mercury barometer: an
inverted tube of mercury standing in a reservoir open to the
atmosphere. Sliders: atmospheric pressure p_atm (kPa) and altitude
(which auto-adjusts p_atm via a barometric formula
p(z) = p₀·exp(-z/H)). Height h of mercury column readout live via
p_atm = ρ_Hg·g·h. HUD: h (mm Hg), p_atm (kPa or hPa), altitude (m).
Experiment: match a target h (mm Hg) by choosing altitude. Evaluate:
mercury column hidden; student estimates h at a given altitude.
Wrinkle: unit gymnastics — mm Hg, hPa, bar — surfaced explicitly.
